methodology.source: raw OANDA bid/ask M15 candles fetched at runtime
methodology.setup: Asian range 00:00-07:00 Europe/London; first 08:00 London M15 close beyond the range
methodology.filters: Asian range 0.35-1.2 session-volatility units; stop beyond opposite range plus 0.1 M15 ATR; risk 0.4-2.5 session-volatility units
methodology.exit: 1.5R target, production labelOutcome bid/ask resolver, forced-session/time close
methodology.controls: exact inverse with separate bid/ask fill and identical risk/target distance; 100 deterministic random arms
methodology.excluded: all recorded trades and database reads/writes

development.gate: n >= 35; positive expectancy; 95% normal CI lower bound > 0; original beats inverse and at least 95/100 random controls
